title: Vow and Bakery
author: Paloma Galloway
blurb: August Marchetti, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
